Dear Margot and Elisa,

I am thrilled to apply for the Digital Marketing Intern position at Fantail. As a junior digital marketer with a technical edge and a passion for data-driven growth, I am eager to contribute to your mission of elevating pet care with premium, sustainable products.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained hands-on experience in on-page SEO, content creation, and WordPress site management. I regularly analyze performance data using tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs to inform decisions, and I am comfortable with Google Ads. Fantail's emphasis on brand building resonates with me. I understand that effective performance marketing is rooted in a strong, cohesive brand identity. My experience building mirook.com from scratch taught me the importance of aligning every touchpoint with the brand's aesthetic and values. # Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support.
